name: Air Base Garry
groundLayout: Runway 4/22, with a Run Up Area near the Rwy 22 end and a Backtrack Area near the Rwy 4 end. Taxiway A runs the length of the field alongside the runway, from hold point B (near Rwy 22) south through hold point C (near the Spawn Ramp) down to the Hangars near the Rwy 4 end. Along the way A serves the Spawn Ramp, Control Tower, Barracks, Fuel, and Helipads. Only A, B, and C are real taxiway/hold-point letters here.
